title: SpecKit Pilot should auto-load assigned tickets on open (Import becomes a manual reload)
scope:
# Summary

Opening the SpecKit Pilot board should automatically pull down assigned ticket data (Linear/Jira) and reconcile it onto the board on load — no manual import step required. The existing "Import ticket" button should remain, but as a manual reload/refresh option rather than the only way to get tickets onto the board.

# Context

Today the board only fetches ticket data when the user explicitly opens the Import ticket modal — `ImportTicketModal` calls `ticketList()` on mount and the user picks tickets one at a time to create cards. Users expect their assigned work to appear as soon as they open the extension. The main tradeoff is that an automatic fetch on load adds a network call at startup and requires deduplication so re-opening/reloading does not create duplicate cards for tickets already on the board.

# Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Opening SpecKit Pilot automatically fetches assigned tickets from configured sources (Linear/Jira) without any manual action
- [ ] Fetched tickets that are not already cards appear on the board (e.g. in Backlog)
- [ ] Re-opening or reloading does not create duplicate cards for tickets already imported (dedup by ticket source key)
- [ ] The "Import ticket" button remains available and now acts as a manual reload/refresh
- [ ] If no source is configured or the fetch fails, the board still loads and surfaces the error via a toast (no crash)
- [ ] Auto-load respects the existing assignee filter (only the user's assigned tickets), consistent with current `ticketList` behavior

# Dev Hints

* Current manual path: `extensions/speckit-pilot/src/renderer/components/ImportTicketModal.tsx` fetches via `getSpeckitAPI().ticketList()` on mount, then calls `cardCreate()` per selected ticket.
* Fetch source (assignee-filtered): `extensions/speckit-pilot/src/api/linear.ts` `fetchAssignedTickets()`.
* Board home + overlay wiring: `extensions/speckit-pilot/src/renderer/App.tsx` (`overlay === 'import'`, `BoardView`).
* Reuse the existing `cardCreate` / card-list IPC for reconciliation; dedup on the ticket source key (`Ticket.key` / Linear `identifier`).
* Keep the `Download` icon affordance for the manual refresh.
